name: counterexample_anatomy_protocol

primary_classes.hosted_failed_gate: hosted == 1 and at least one of B,Q,C,S is below the frozen threshold
primary_classes.hosted_all_gates_pass: hosted == 1 and all four frozen gates pass
primary_classes.nonhosted_all_gates_pass: hosted == 0 and all four frozen gates pass
primary_classes.nonhosted_failed_gate: hosted == 0 and at least one of B,Q,C,S is below the frozen threshold

revision_target: Hosted transformation should be studied as relational routing among boundary, organization, capture response, reserve, input form, and history, not as a hard intersection of four independent gates.
capture_revision_hypothesis: C = C(B, Q, S, input, current_load, history)

exit_criteria.stage4_1: counterexample anatomy artifacts created while final test remains sealed
exit_criteria.stage4_2: decision whether to revise manuscript, create fresh development cycle, preregister Stage 5, or stop line as negative result
